app.name: Samavesh
footer.text: Samavesh is a final-year B.Tech project, built to WCAG 2.1 Level AA.
home.title: Support, compliance and grievance redressal in one accessible place
home.intro: Samavesh helps a higher-education institution record accommodation plans, track the support actually delivered, monitor its statutory obligations and resolve grievances.
hint.password: At least 10 characters. A phrase of several words is easy to remember.
hint.code: Enter the code from the email we sent you.
hint.date_of_birth: Students only. If you are under 18 we ask a parent or guardian for consent before creating your support profile.
login.title: Sign in
login.forgot: Forgot your password, or setting one for the first time?
login.timeout: You were signed out because you were inactive for 30 minutes. Sign in again to continue.
login.passwordSet: Your password has been set. Sign in to continue.
register.title: Create an account
register.intro: Students and their parents or guardians can register here. Staff accounts are created by an administrator.
register.haveAccount: Already have an account? Sign in
verify.title: Check your email
verify.intro: We sent a 6-digit code to {email}. It expires in 10 minutes.
verify.resent: A new code has been sent.
verify.outbox: Development mode: open the email outbox
reset.title: Set or reset your password
reset.intro: Enter your email address and we will send you a 6-digit code.
reset.sent: If an account exists for {email}, a code has been sent. It expires in 10 minutes.
dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.empty: More sections will appear here as they are switched on for your role.
users.title: Users
users.caption: All accounts
users.name: Name
users.invite.title: Invite a staff member
users.invite.intro: They receive an email asking them to set a password.
users.deactivated: {name} has been deactivated and signed out.
settings.title: Display settings
settings.intro: These settings are saved on this device.
timeout.title: Are you still there?
timeout.body: For your security you will be signed out in about 2 minutes because you have not been active.
outbox.title: Development email outbox
outbox.intro: Emails are listed here instead of being sent because SMTP is not configured. This page does not exist in production.
outbox.caption: Most recent emails
outbox.subject: Subject
error.email: Enter an email address in the format name@example.com
error.code: Enter the 6 digits from the email
error.invalid_credentials: The email address or password is not correct.
error.account_locked: Too many failed attempts. Try again in 15 minutes.
error.account_disabled: This account has been deactivated. Contact an administrator.
error.code_invalid: That code is not correct. Check the email and try again.
error.code_expired: That code has expired. Request a new one.
error.code_locked: Too many wrong attempts with that code. Request a new one.
error.too_many_codes: You have requested too many codes. Try again in an hour.
error.email_taken: An account with that email address already exists.
error.cannot_modify_self: You cannot deactivate your own account.
error.forbidden: You do not have permission to do that.
error.not_authenticated: Your session has ended. Sign in again.
error.api_unreachable: The service is not responding. Try again in a moment.
